correctness.rationale: For m≥3, Haar-independent successive torus differences lift to independent uniform Voronoi cell increments Z_j. The closing edge subtracts the Voronoi representative R of their sum, so W=S−R and the symmetric fundamental domain yields P(W=λ)=v f^{*m}(λ). For m−1≥2, conditioning on any one Z_j leaves an independent uniform residual modulo L, proving E[S R^T]=0 and Cov(W)=mΣ. Fourier inversion for bounded full-dimensional cell density, strict |φ(ξ)|<1 off zero, and Gaussian expansion imply the fixed-lattice uniform O(m^(−d/2−1)) approximation. For product lattices this reduces to classical B-splines at integers. Independent exact fractional checks confirmed probabilities P(W_{3,1}=0)=3/4,P(W_{4,1}=0)=2/3,P(W_{5,1}=0)=115/192, normalization and moment m/12 for m≤10. The m=2 loop retraces and lies outside the claim.
residual_risks: The all-d Fourier estimate was inspected analytically; finite spline calculations alone do not prove it.
